parameters.name: IstioGatewayName
parameters.description: The name of the ASM gateway.

parameters.name: Priority
parameters.description: The route priority. This is an integer. A smaller value indicates a higher priority.

parameters.name: ServiceMeshId
parameters.description: The ID of the Service Mesh (ASM) instance.

parameters.name: Status
parameters.description: The status of the route. A value of 0 indicates that the route is published. A value of 1 indicates that the route is unpublished. A value of 2 indicates that a fault occurred when the route was created or updated.
